reproduction: ops.create_ad_bid_command is callable by the application role and accepts p_actor_id, p_bundle_id and p_approval_expires_at as caller parameters.

required_verification: Direct SQL impersonation must fail even when the nominated UUID has valid scopes.
Application service positive path and DB privilege matrix tests.
